name: Ukk (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white and green in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ukk: a blue and red shield with a yellow well-sweep, white flowers and a ploughshare.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
